name: Soprano
summary: A tiny (80M) English voice that runs many times faster than real time. One voice, no cloning.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.summary: Free to use, change and sell, including commercially. Keep the licence notice if you redistribute the model.

parameters.label: Variation
parameters.help: Higher sounds livelier and less predictable; lower sounds steadier.

parameters.label: Top-p
parameters.help: Only tokens within this share of probability are considered. Lower is safer; 1 turns the filter off.

parameters.label: Repetition penalty
parameters.help: Discourages the model from looping on the same sounds. 1 turns it off.

parameters.label: Length limit
parameters.help: Hard cap on generated audio per pass. Lower it only to stop runaway output.

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.help: Fix this to get the same take again from the same settings. Leave empty for a fresh take each time.
